Name: Sewer Redone
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]Its a subtle edit of the sewer map. recolors the running water to a more blue/violett color (original greenish). gives the altar a real place. slight resizing of the water basin. thats it.

I wanted to stay close to vanilla game but make some small changes.

I did not like the greenish color of the running water from bugland (espacially after trash bear cleans the outside and it doesnt fit anymore).

In additon, i found the altar at the side to the entrance of bugland slightly misplaced in a corridor. So i gave it a real place which highlights the importance a bit more.
